meta.name: Happy Endings: More Like Stanksgiving
meta.description:
Happy Endings · Season 3, Episode 4 · aired 2012-11-20

Dave decides to give his friends an authentic Navajo Thanksgiving which doesn't go well. The rest of the gang watch the episode of Real World: Sacramento where they all went to visit Max.
